module "P_VectorWidths.dss"

product 0 Material "M_VectorWidths" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0, 0), ParameterName="Triple", SortPriority=1) : float4 @L6:C1 "Triple"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L6:C1 "BaseColor"
  %2 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 1, 1, 1), ParameterName="Quad", SortPriority=2) : float4 @L7:C1 "Quad"
  %3 = Swizzle(%2, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L12:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %4 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 1), ParameterName="Pair", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L5:C1 "Pair"
  %5 = Swizzle(%4, Mask="xy") : float2 @L5:C1 "Opacity"
  %6 = Swizzle(%4, Mask="x") : float @L13:C17 "Opacity"
  %7 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L14:C29 "Normal"
  %8 = Append(%5, %7) : float3 @L14:C16 "Normal"
  %9 = MaterialSink(BaseColor=%1, EmissiveColor=%3, Opacity=%6, Normal=%8) @L9:C1
  sink %9
